findings.issue: गर्म घंटियाँ evokes physical hot bells rather than warm timbre; use a clear musical metaphor.
findings.suggestion: सिंथ · गरमाहट भरी घंटियों की ध्वनि, पैड और धड़कन
findings.context: Music palette preset; retain synth pads technical loanword

findings.problem: झुंड means a troop/group; this refers to the colony unit-production Swarm building. Align with the independently settled native glossary छत्ता.
findings.rationale: Skins.tsx:710,914,929 and skins/swarmShapes.ts:5 refer to the rendered building model. Native editor checked BuildingTypesColony.cpp and French Ruche. Preserve literal swarm model/API identifiers.

snapshot_note: Online catalog hash and batch subset hash bind this online-only review. Native catalog snapshot is contextual and was being edited independently; it is not a native-review claim.

recheck.result: All changed keys independently reread; unchanged keys carried forward by exact original snapshot reconstruction; no open linguistic finding.
